title: SplitPayment via TBA
tagline: A portal where user can choose to pay for a transaction using multiple account
description: A frontend where user can select their multiple accounts to pay for a transaction by specifying the percentage of amount from each accounts. Each account here will be ERC4337 compliant account. For submitting the transactions/userOperation we will be using pimlico infrastructure.
how_its_made:
Frontend here is envisioned to be developed using reactjs/nextjs, 
For splitting the payments across multiple account we will be using multicall pattern along with account abstraction with session keys , all contracts will be written in solidity and developed using hardhat. We will deploy the  contracts on polygon pos chain to test the idea.
